name: nft-jump-goto-sub-sub-counts
description: goto-sub with a chain that counts the peer without reaching a verdict
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add chain inet f sub
nft add rule inet f sub ip daddr 10.5.5.2 counter

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out goto sub
